			rruleStr += ';BYWEEKDAY=' + byWeekDay

	return rruleStr

value = int(value)
	return [
		{'label': 'Day' if value == 1 else 'Days', 'value': 'DAILY'},
		{'label': 'Week' if value == 1 else 'Weeks', 'value': 'WEEKLY'},
		{'label': 'Month' if value == 1 else 'Months', 'value': 'MONTHLY'},
		{'label': 'Year' if value == 1 else 'Years', 'value': 'YEARLY'}
	]

startDate = value or None
	if startDate is None: return []
	
	dayOfMonth = system.date.getDayOfMonth(startDate)
	
	weekdayNames = ["Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"]
	dayOfWeek = system.date.getDayOfWeek(startDate)
	weekdayName = weekdayNames[dayOfWeek-1]
	lastDayOfMonth = system.date.getDayOfMonth(system.date.addDays(system.date.addMonths(startDate, 1), -dayOfMonth - 1))
	
	weeksOfMonth = ['1st', '2nd', '3rd', '4th', '5th']
	weekOfMonth = dayOfMonth // 7
	
	options = []
	options.append({'label': 'Monthly on day %d' % dayOfMonth, 'value': system.util.jsonEncode({'choice': 'nth day of month', 'dayOfMonth': dayOfMonth})})
	options.append({'label': 'Monthly on the %s %s' % (weeksOfMonth[weekOfMonth], weekdayName), 'value': system.util.jsonEncode({'choice': 'nth weekday of month', 'weekOfMonth': weekOfMonth + 1, 'dayOfWeek': dayOfWeek})})

	return options

	if value['ends']['selection'] != 'never' and rrule['UNTIL'] is None: return False
